by
  -- We need to show that a + ⨆ i, f i is the supremum of {a + f i | i : ι}
  -- This can be done by showing that it is an upper bound and that any other upper bound is greater or equal.
  -- First, show that a + ⨆ i, f i is an upper bound for {a + f i | i : ι}
  apply add_ciSup_le
  intros i
  exact le_add_right (le_ciSup f hf)
  -- Next, show that any upper bound for {a + f i | i : ι} is ≥ a + ⨆ i, f i
  -- Since a + f i ≤ a + ⨆ i, f i for all i, then ⨆ i, a + f i ≤ a + ⨆ i, f i
  -- By the same reasoning, we can also show that a + ⨆ i, f i ≤ ⨆ i, a + f i
  -- Thus, the two are equal
  apply add_ciSup_le
  intros i
  exact le_add_left (le_ciSup f hf)
